entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
entities.description: A substate chosen in the UE while the UE is searching for PLMNs or SNPNs. This substate is not applicable to non-3GPP access.

entities.name: UE searching for PLMNs or SNPNs
entities.description: Condition where the UE is actively searching for PLMNs or SNPNs.

entities.name: Not applicable to non-3GPP access
entities.description: Property indicating this substate is not applicable when using non-3GPP access.

relations.description: The condition of UE searching for PLMNs or SNPNs establishes the 5GMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH substate.
The substate is guarded by the property that it is not applicable to non-3GPP access.
